court: Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit

issues.label: RLUIPA damages unavailable
issues.why: Whether RLUIPA permits monetary damages against state officials in official or individual capacities.

issues.label: Eleventh Amendment official-capacity immunity
issues.why: Whether sovereign immunity bars damages claims against defendants in their official capacities.

issues.label: Mootness of injunctive relief
issues.why: Whether VDOC's 2021 creation of a Ramadan-compliant OJKD moots Roberts's request for injunctive relief.

issues.label: Voluntary cessation exception to mootness
issues.why: Whether VDOC's policy change could be reversed, defeating mootness under the voluntary-cessation doctrine.

issues.label: RLUIPA substantial burden
issues.why: Whether forcing the OJKD/Ramadan choice imposed a substantial burden on Roberts's religious exercise.

issues.label: RLUIPA compelling interest and least restrictive means
issues.why: Whether VDOC's food safety and planning justifications satisfy strict scrutiny.

issues.label: Free Exercise clearly established law
issues.why: Whether qualified immunity applies because the right was not clearly established for Roberts's specific belief.

issues.label: Free Exercise substantive violation
issues.why: Whether refusing accommodation violated the First Amendment under the Turner reasonableness standard.

issues.label: Turner v. Safley legitimate penological interest
issues.why: Whether the restriction was reasonably related to legitimate penological interests like safety and cost.

issues.label: Sincerity vs. religious requirement
issues.why: Whether the court properly distinguished sincere belief from whether Islam actually requires Rabbi-supervised meals.

issues.label: Establishment Clause claim merits
issues.why: Whether VDOC's religious diet programs impermissibly favor certain faiths.

issues.label: Equal Protection differential treatment
issues.why: Whether Jewish inmates' accommodations versus Roberts's treatment constitute unlawful discrimination.

issues.label: Equal Protection similarly situated comparators
issues.why: Whether Roberts was similarly situated to Jewish inmates receiving OJKD Ramadan accommodations.

issues.label: Qualified immunity two-step analysis
issues.why: Whether each constitutional claim satisfies both violation and clearly-established prongs.

issues.label: Punitive damages availability
issues.why: Whether defendants' conduct meets the standard for punitive damages under the constitutional claims.

issues.label: Personal involvement of each defendant
issues.why: Whether each named official was personally involved to support individual-capacity liability.

issues.label: Declaratory judgment availability
issues.why: Whether a declaratory judgment on past conduct remains available given mootness and immunity findings.

issues.label: Motion to compel discovery review
issues.why: Whether the magistrate's denial of Roberts's motion to compel Food Manual documents was proper.

issues.label: Pro se pleading liberal construction
issues.why: Whether Roberts's pro se filings were liberally construed as required.

issues.label: Summary judgment standard and factual inferences
issues.why: Whether disputed material facts viewed favorably to Roberts precluded summary judgment.

issues.label: Exhaustion of administrative remedies
issues.why: Whether Roberts exhausted VDOC grievance procedures as required by the PLRA.

issues.label: PLRA physical injury requirement
issues.why: Whether Roberts's food-poisoning illness satisfies the physical-injury prerequisite for compensatory damages.

issues.label: Availability of nominal damages
issues.why: Whether nominal damages remain available even absent compensatory damages or mootness.

issues.label: Standing for injunctive relief
issues.why: Whether Roberts retains standing to seek prospective relief given current accommodation.
